column1: KF Console Blueprints will allow for the installation of [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_KerbyInjectors],Kerby Injectors]], [[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_FuCapacitor],Fu Capacitor]]s and a Cheatah Navigation Computer to create a Kerby-Fucheatah Console. The KF Console will allow for the calculation of Pirate Jump Points to allow for quicker travel to other systems, with the added risk of possible misjumps.\n\nThis item is for Argo upgrade only, it will not install in mechs
column2: 【KFC蓝图】KF控制台蓝图可用于安装[[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_KerbyInjectors],Kerby 注射器]]、[[DM.UpgradeDefs[Gear_FuCapacitor],Fu 电容器]]和 Cheatah 导航计算机，从而组装成 Kerby-Fucheatah 控制台。KF 控制台可计算海盗跃迁点，帮助更快地前往其他星系，但也有误跳的风险。\n\n此物品仅供阿耳戈号升级使用，无法安装在机甲上
